description: Open a new ticket on behalf of a contact (created if the email is new). Needs a category id (a public category), a subject and a message in `text` or `html`. HappyFox: POST /api/1.1/json/tickets/.

assignee.description: Agent id to assign the ticket to (from happyfox_list_staff); null to unassign.

bcc.description: BCC email addresses, as a comma-separated string.

category.description: The category (happyfox_list_categories; must be public) id.

cc.description: CC email addresses, as a comma-separated string.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed "t-cf-<id>" / "c-cf-<id>". Ticket (t-cf-) and contact (c-cf-) fields; required ones must be present. Values: text = string, number = number, dropdown = choice id, multiple choice = array of choice ids, date = yyyy-mm-dd.

html.description: Message in HTML (text or html is required).

priority.description: Priority id (happyfox_list_priorities); defaults to the default priority.

text.description: Message in plain text (text or html is required).

visible_only_staff.description: true = private ticket, visible to staff only.

name: happyfox_create_ticket
title: Create a ticket
